subject: Removing ggtree labels based on a criteria from metadata

messages.author: 7924b4f70771f3ec
messages.subject: Removing ggtree labels based on a criteria from metadata
parts:
Hi!
I'm using ggtree to visualise a phylogeny in R, and I've managed to add coloured labels (the colours being based on a variable from some metadata). However, the majority of labels have no value available in the metadata to classify them by, and I would like to hide these so I can see the ones that do. Please can you help me to remove or hide these labels in ggtree?
Best wishes,
Hugh White
